migration_subtitle: Migrate assets from your TON wallets
migration_prepare_title: Migrate assets from your TON wallets
migration_prepare_description: Choose a TON wallet to migrate from. Its assets will be moved to multichain.
migration_empty_description: Add a TON wallet with assets to migrate them to this wallet.
migration_how_it_works_intro: We’ll move supported assets from your TON wallet to multichain. Unsupported assets will stay in your TON wallet.
migration_how_it_works_will_migrate: Will migrate: verified jettons and NFTs, TON DNS NFTs, Telegram usernames and numbers, as well as liquid staking tokens like tsTON.
migration_how_it_works_will_stay: Will stay in your TON wallet: unverified or blacklisted assets, lending positions, non-liquid staking positions, SBT and Tonstakers NFTs.
migration_how_it_works_note: Please note: TON DNS NFTs will migrate, but rebinding them to your new address is done manually.
migration_insufficient_trx_title: Insufficient TRX for fees in wallet
migration_insufficient_funds_title: Insufficient funds for fees in wallet
migration_only_tron_note: Only TRON transactions will be sent now. TON transactions will be paused until you add more TON.

migration_battery_send_failed: Battery couldn't send the transaction. Try again with the fee paid from your wallet balance.
